output.alt_text: Runtime events, timestamps, summaries, and checkpoints begin as untrusted evidence. Admission authenticates producer and tenant, verifies an Ed25519 signature, time, sequence, and previous digest. A chronology verifier checks required IDs, source high-watermarks, gaps, tampering, and creates a digest bound into the validated checkpoint. The provider is queried with each original logical operation ID. A classifier skips committed effects, permits authoritative absence, or retains reconcile, review, and denial states. An exact single-use approval and current authorization gate precede provider dispatch. The provider may commit then time out, so a separate postcondition query verifies identical intent and authoritative state. Recovery ends recovered or recovery-incomplete; incomplete state requires reconciliation and a new versioned plan rather than blind retry.
